records.goal_type:
Derivation.validResponse Derivation.R2F 1 2 (ResearchG01.deltaF 1) ∧
  Derivation.validResponse Derivation.R2F 1 2 (ResearchG01.deltaF 2) ∧
    (ResearchG01.deltaF 1).length = 2 ∧
      (ResearchG01.deltaF 2).length = 2 ∧
        (∀ (δ : List Derivation.Item), δ.length ≤ 1 → ¬Derivation.validResponse Derivation.R2F 1 2 δ) ∧
          Derivation.applyDelta Derivation.R2F (ResearchG01.deltaF 1) = some (ResearchG01.markF 1) ∧
            Derivation.applyDelta Derivation.R2F (ResearchG01.deltaF 2) = some (ResearchG01.markF 2) ∧
              ∀ (a : Derivation.Iso (ResearchG01.markF 1) (ResearchG01.markF 2)), False

(∀ (i : Nat),
    i < 5 →
      Derivation.validResponse Derivation.R2F 1 2 (ResearchG01.delta (ResearchG01.boundedArgs i)) ∧
        (ResearchG01.delta (ResearchG01.boundedArgs i)).length = 2 ∧
          (ResearchG01.boundedArgs i).length ≤ 2 ∧
            Derivation.applyDelta Derivation.R2F (ResearchG01.delta (ResearchG01.boundedArgs i)) =
              some (ResearchG01.state (ResearchG01.boundedArgs i))) ∧
  ∀ (i j : Nat),
    i < j →
      j < 5 →
        ∀
          (a :
            Derivation.Iso (ResearchG01.state (ResearchG01.boundedArgs i))
              (ResearchG01.state (ResearchG01.boundedArgs j))),
          False

(∀ (k : Nat),
    1 ≤ k →
      Derivation.validResponse Derivation.R2F 1 2 (ResearchG01.deltaF k) ∧
        (ResearchG01.deltaF k).length = 2 ∧
          Derivation.applyDelta Derivation.R2F (ResearchG01.deltaF k) = some (ResearchG01.markF k)) ∧
  ∀ (j k : Nat), j ≠ k → ∀ (a : Derivation.Iso (ResearchG01.markF j) (ResearchG01.markF k)), False

(∀ (i : Nat),
    i < 5 →
      Derivation.validResponse ResearchG01.relabelledBase 0 2 (ResearchG01.delta (ResearchG01.relabelledArgs i)) ∧
        (ResearchG01.delta (ResearchG01.relabelledArgs i)).length = 2 ∧
          (ResearchG01.relabelledArgs i).length ≤ 2 ∧
            Derivation.applyDelta ResearchG01.relabelledBase (ResearchG01.delta (ResearchG01.relabelledArgs i)) =
              some (ResearchG01.relabelledState (ResearchG01.relabelledArgs i))) ∧
  ∀ (i j : Nat),
    i < j →
      j < 5 →
        ∀
          (a :
            Derivation.Iso (ResearchG01.relabelledState (ResearchG01.relabelledArgs i))
              (ResearchG01.relabelledState (ResearchG01.relabelledArgs j))),
          False

ResearchG01.markF 1 = ResearchG01.state (ResearchG01.boundedArgs 0) ∧
  ResearchG01.markF 2 = ResearchG01.state (ResearchG01.boundedArgs 1) ∧
    Nonempty (Derivation.Iso (ResearchG01.markF 1) (ResearchG01.state (ResearchG01.boundedArgs 0))) ∧
      Nonempty (Derivation.Iso (ResearchG01.markF 2) (ResearchG01.state (ResearchG01.boundedArgs 1)))

∀ (a b : Derivation.Item),
  Derivation.validResponse Derivation.R2F 1 2 [a, b] →
    Derivation.aritySum [a, b] ≤ 1 →
      ∃ s, Derivation.applyDelta Derivation.R2F [a, b] = some s ∧ Nonempty (Derivation.Iso s Derivation.U0F)

∀ (xs ys : List Nat)
  (a :
    Derivation.Iso (ResearchG01.state xs)
      { data := 2, forms := [ys.length], insts := [(0, ys)], rules := [], reqs := [(0, 1)] }),
  False
